explication: This repository is a standalone Engram demonstration, not a production model-serving system. Its intended workflow is to run the demo, form token n-grams, hash them into static memory, and fuse retrieved embeddings with hidden states in selected transformer blocks. The implementation also includes a compressed tokenizer and short convolution; attention and MoE are explicitly mocked. The available excerpts do not show the full script entry-point wiring or Engram forward pass, so those internal links are limited to relationships visible in the excerpts or documented in the README.
